== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Walker Barrage (Japanese)|Walker Barrage]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/154944013/5RAgZeC5BkehZXPgei4BFA.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 88099884.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>28379f29c078bdba021c0c7cfb0a991c6e18dd092bc5d1a9aaa95c16d2cee1d3</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
